experiment: E2C-v3 multi-seed x multi-forget-set matrix (PPUBench, MLLMU-Bench, SALMUBench)

design.routes: frozen committed pilot checkpoints (g never edited or retrained)
design.forget_semantics: every target driven to refusal label 'Unknown' in ONE edited h per (set, seed); all other identities retain their route aliases
design.simultaneity_guarantee: one training run and one checkpoint per (set, seed); all targets evaluated on the same model; per-cell checkpoint SHA-256 recorded in cells_index.json and the run manifest

sets.ppubench: 4 single rotations + 3 seed-17-drawn pairwise stress sets = 7 sets x 3 seeds = 21 cells; pilot oracle reused for {001} (exact exclusion match)
sets.mllmu: 6 singles (one per profession) + 3 simultaneous 3-target sets spanning distinct professions = 9 sets x 3 seeds = 27 cells; 9 fresh leave-one-out oracles
sets.salmu: 6 singles round-robin over (level2, level1) taxonomy groups + 3 simultaneous 3-target sets each spanning >=2 level-2 groups = 9 sets x 3 seeds = 27 cells; 9 fresh leave-one-out oracles

headline_results.worst_seed_visible: per-seed values recorded for every set; no set passed on some seeds and failed on others (std = 0 on pass/fail criteria across all sets)

mllmu.held_out_g_routing_note: MLLMU-Bench has ONE image per identity; image-level held-out routing does not exist (stated limitation)
mllmu.qa_warning: Native QA preservation is NOT ESTABLISHED: base model is at floor (1/36) pre-edit, so the flat probe delta (1/36 post in all 27 cells) only rules out large collateral shifts above that floor

salmu.e2e_unconditional: 0.947-0.970 (bounded by frozen-g routing: 125/132 code-correct, 1 unroutable held-out image from the pilot)
salmu.held_out_g_routing: 0.8056 (frozen route, decode-fixed rescore; gate FAIL at 0.90 reported as pilot limitation)
salmu.unparseable_h_outputs: 0 true h-side; the committed per-cell h_unparseable_outputs=1 counts the single unrouted row where h was never queried (metric definition fixed in the runner post-run; g_routing_failures is the correct field)

interpretation.simultaneous_multi_target: 3-target (MLLMU/SALMU) and 2-target (PPUBench) simultaneous suppression in a single edited h matches single-target reliability exactly: 100% pass, retention 1.000, target original-label probability <= 1.5e-05, across all three seeds
interpretation.seed_stability: no seed-dependent failures: pass/fail identical across seeds 17/42/123 for every set; failure counts (leak, retain-broken, OOV, catastrophic) are zero everywhere, so no catastrophic-single-seed events exist to hide
interpretation.oracle_semantics: retained identities are distributionally indistinguishable from the leave-one-out retraining oracle over the candidate label space (L2 <= 2e-4); targets are far from the oracle (L2 ~1.3-1.4) because the oracle does not know excluded codes while the edit maps them to refusal - refusal edits are NOT oracle-equivalent, consistent with RV3/PPUBench pilots
interpretation.e2e_scoping: unconditional E2E equals conditional E2E wherever g routes all images (PPUBench, MLLMU); on SALMU the gap (1.000 vs ~0.95) is entirely frozen-g held-out routing, not the edit

checkpoint_durability.integrity: every archived file has SHA-256 in CHECKSUMS.txt + archive_manifest.json with immutable HF resolve URI; per-cell checkpoint_sha256 in cell_results.json matches the archive entry; results are exactly reloadable
